title: Make a Cat Then Animate
tests: Tests completing picture creation and animation from one message, delivering both assets with matching subjects.

faults.what: The cat has two visible striped tails: one swishes on its left while another hangs down on its right throughout the sampled frames.
No standalone still picture is shown among the delivered outputs; only video frames are provided.

judge.summary: The sunny square animation shows the requested cat blinking and swishing a tail, but the cat has two tails and no standalone picture is provided.

must_haves.item: Both a standalone still picture and a playable 5-second video are delivered.
must_haves.why: A 5.2-second MP4 is identified and sampled, but no separate still-picture output is provided.

must_haves.item: Both outputs are square and show an orange cat wearing a blue scarf on a sunny windowsill.
must_haves.why: The video frames are square and clearly show the requested subject and setting, but the required standalone picture is absent.

must_haves.item: The animation visibly matches the delivered illustration's cat, scarf and setting.
must_haves.why: There is no separate delivered illustration available for comparison.

must_haves.item: The cat visibly blinks and its tail gently moves; the video is not merely a still image with a camera zoom.
must_haves.why: The eyes are closed in the first sample and open in later samples, and the left-side tail visibly changes position and curvature independently of the setting.

must_haves.item: The video has no audible sound.
must_haves.why: Silent image samples cannot establish whether the video contains audible sound.
